zh.title: 加州房产税与房屋保险：房主要看懂的几件事
zh.seo_title: 加州房产税与房屋保险指南｜陈靖
zh.description: 讲清 Prop 13 的计税方式、Homeowners' Exemption、补充税单、Prop 19、FAIR Plan 和 CEA 地震险，以及湾区房主每年该核对的日期、表格和保单项目。
zh.lead: 房产税和保险每年都要付，却很少有人把账单和保单逐项看过。这篇按账单上的顺序讲一遍，并列出湾区房主需要留意的日期。

en.title: California Property Tax and Home Insurance: What Owners Should Know
en.seo_title: California Property Tax & Home Insurance | Jing Chen
en.description: How Prop 13, the Homeowners' Exemption, supplemental bills, Prop 19, the FAIR Plan and CEA earthquake coverage work for Bay Area homeowners.
en.lead: You pay these two bills every year, but few owners read them line by line. Here is what each piece means and which dates matter in the Bay Area.
